title: Specialty Pharmacy Program: Member Payments Toward a Shipped Fill
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Specialty Pharmacy Program sets the **member payment**: the payment a member makes with the member's own card on the latest shipped fill of a specialty enrollment. It applies where both of the following hold:

- the enrollment's program coordinates manufacturer assistance by standard coordination or by variable copay;
- the enrollment is not on hold for an overdue payment.

Earlier fills are settled first under the oldest-first rule. The rule therefore covers a payment on the latest shipped fill once no earlier fill of the enrollment is left unpaid.

## When the payment is figured

The member payment on the latest shipped fill is figured only after the fill carries the copay card payment owed on it.

In other words, the member payment on that fill is not figured while the copay card payment owed on the fill is not yet carried on it.

## What the payment does

The payment is the member's own payment, made with the member's own instrument, toward the member cost share of one shipped specialty fill. It posts the member's payment against that fill and lowers the member's balance due on the enrollment by the amount paid. Afterwards the payment appears in the enrollment's payment history against that fill, and the balance due shows the reduction.

## How it is invoked

The action is `pay_fill_balance_998729ec`, a tool the member runs. The agent unlocks it and hands it over to the customer themselves, meaning the member, who runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `specialty_enrollment_id` | Reference number of the member's specialty therapy enrollment, as the agent reads it out from the specialty enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `specialty_fill_id` | Reference number of the shipped fill being paid, as the agent reads it out from the specialty fill lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The amount the member pays now | USD, a positive amount to 2 decimal places (nearest cent) |
| `payment_method` | The instrument the member pays with | One of: `credit_card` (a credit card); `debit_card` (a bank debit card); `hsa_fsa_card` (a health savings account or flexible spending account card); `check` (an electronic check from a checking account). `copay_card` is reserved for manufacturer program payments, and `not_applicable` is reserved for entries that are not payments; neither is ever the instrument of a member's own payment. |

## Return

On success the receipt contains:

- `status`: "posted";
- `payment_entry_id`: reference number of the member payment entry;
- `specialty_fill_id`: the fill paid;
- `amount`: the amount paid, in USD to 2 decimal places;
- `payment_method`: the instrument recorded;
- `balance_due`: the member's balance due on the enrollment after the payment, in USD to 2 decimal places.
